I don’t have real‑time data access, so I can’t give you the current temperature or forecast for London right now.  
If you’d like up‑to‑date weather information, you can check a reliable source such as:

- **BBC Weather** – https://www.bbc.com/weather/2643743  
- **Weather.com** – https://weather.com/weather/today/l/London  
- **OpenWeatherMap API** (if you want programmatic access) – https://openweathermap.org/api  

Those sites will give you the latest temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a short‑term forecast. If you need help interpreting the data or setting up an API call, let me know!
